description: Source code for the 'app' package managing AI plugin bridge interactions, including plugin status checks, agent retrieval, user mapping, and LLM service fetching in Mattermost.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for plugin interaction and data retrieval.

methods.name: GetBridgeClient
methods.description: Creates a new bridge client for API requests using the user ID.

methods.name: GetAIPluginBridgeStatus
methods.description: Checks if the AI plugin is active and supports the required bridge API version.

methods.name: GetAgents
methods.description: Retrieves all available agents from the bridge API.

methods.name: GetUsersForAgents
methods.description: Maps agents to user objects based on their usernames.

methods.name: GetLLMServices
methods.description: Retrieves available LLM services from the bridge API.
